summary: Level crest of a residential street where cars park; homes 12-13m away.
reasons: Cars park along the west kerb

drivers.seclusion: West-side houses sit 10 to 15m from the kerb all along; east-side homes about 19m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerbside parking lane on the west side and several cars already parked.
drivers.traffic: Short residential street off a cross road, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, so a van blends in; no campers seen.

flags: Steep elsewhere: 7.2% mean, 14.5% max over the full stretch
sun_shade: Open sun; garden trees shade parts of the west kerb in the afternoon.

best_section.where: At the crest of Normanby Street, west kerb in front of the houses
